title: pluginuploader
description:
This is a custome plugin with that you can upload custome plugin with the direct download link. 

command: /pluginupload <link>
body:
This is a custom Minecraft plugin designed to make managing your server easier and more flexible. With PluginUploader, you can add new plugins directly to your server without the need to manually download them, move files, or restart your server multiple times. The plugin simplifies the process by allowing you to use a single command to download and store plugins from direct download links.

To use the plugin, simply type /pluginupload <link> in the server console or as a player with the appropriate permissions. The link must point to a direct .jar file of the plugin you want to add. PluginUploader supports standard direct download links, Google Drive links, and other hosting services. Google Drive links are automatically converted into direct download links to ensure the plugin is downloaded correctly.

After running the command, the plugin file is saved in your server’s plugins folder. The system performs several checks to make sure the downloaded file is a valid JAR, preventing errors from corrupted or invalid downloads. Additionally, it provides a clickable message with the corrected link if any adjustments are needed.

PluginUploader is ideal for server owners who frequently add or update plugins, making plugin management faster, safer, and more convenient. This plugin streamlines your workflow and reduces the risk of errors, giving you more time to focus on running and enjoying your Minecraft plugin.
